issue: Dirty source builds collide under the former build identity.
reproducer: Create a Git commit, edit the same tracked file twice without committing, and compute git-<short HEAD>+dirty for each edit.
head: 51dc1a632ded
whyItFailed: The old identifier recorded only whether the worktree was dirty. It did not include the changed source bytes, so the runtime handshake could accept artifacts built from different uncommitted states.
observed: A temporary Git repository reproduced the same identifier for both distinct file contents. The temporary repository was removed after the check.
